body_markdown:
We’re excited to connect with ambulatory practices and health system leaders in Nashville at the Athenahealth Thrive Summit! As healthcare leaders seek new ways to boost revenue cycle performance and workflow efficiency, eFax® is on-site to demonstrate how cloud fax integrations supercharge practice productivity.


Find the eFax® team during the event to learn how our secure communication solutions fit directly into your daily clinical workflows. By automating paper-heavy intake tasks and maintaining strict HIPAA compliance, eFax® helps practice administrators cut processing times, reduce operational bottlenecks, and elevate the patient experience.


[Learn More](https://www.athenahealth.com/resources/events/thrive)
